messages:
ellie: Quick QTR milestone pulse — runtime autoscale + rollout. What shipped, what slipped, next steps? cc @samir @jia
samir: Shipped: continuous batching rollout to 40% of traffic last week. Metrics look good: p95 down 15%.
jia: Platform shipped autoscale policy v2 to staging; still validating scale-down behavior. Found a race when pods scale to 0 during backlog spikes.
marta: SRE saw two incidents tied to cold-start when cache warmup failed — triggered on canary 40% yesterday. Mitigated with fallback to primed pool :white_check_mark:
samir: Filed issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-431 — root cause is KV cache rehydrate ordering. Assigning @samir and @noah
noah: I'm on it, root cause reproducer in my branch. Quick fix: add a pre-warm hook that primes keys for in-flight requests. Testing now.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout 2026.03.16-0920 started -> 40% traffic
jia: Slip: planned full rollout this week; needs one more validation (+2 days). ETA now Fri EOD.
ellie: :point_up: Callout: product expects latency SLO for user-facing completions. If rollout slips, we need fallback routing to smaller model to keep latency.
samir: Agree. Suggest policy: route >50ms P95 requests to gpt-medium variant during incidents. Will add canary config.
marta: Action items: 1) No rollback; continue canary. 2) Noah to PR pre-warm hook. 3) Jia to run scale-down tests. 4) Product to confirm acceptable fallback model. Assigning owners.
ellie: Confirming fallback ok with product for the short term. I'll open a PR with prompt/placeholder routing rules. ETA tomorrow AM.
noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/678 — includes reproducer and pre-warm hook. Running internal e2e.
jia: Test results: scale-down passed in staging, but cost delta +3% due to extra pre-warm cores. Need cost approval.
ellie: Can product accept +3% for initial rollout? If not, we can tune pre-warm targets.
samir: I'll add dynamic pre-warm threshold (only warm when backlog > 10) — should cut cost impact. PR incoming today.
marta: No further incidents since mitigation. Monitoring for 24h, will escalate otherwise.
ellie: Thanks all. I'll summarize for execs: shipped partial canary, minor slip to full rollout (+2d), mitigation in PR, fallback policy ready. Anything else?
samir: Add risk note about KV cache on large sequences. I'll append to summary.
ellie: Done. :white_check_mark: Closing thread — ping here if anything breaks.
